Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the quick demo yesterday. We want to get the Starter (monthly) plan set up this week — volume will be small to start (under $2k/mo). Our procurement team prefers to issue invoices and be paid on net-30; they typically do not generate POs for small vendors during the trial period.

Would Redwood accept invoices without a PO while we finalize the MSA? We can provide a W-9 and a signed copy of the MSA draft, and we can be added to your vendor portal. If a temporary threshold helps, we can agree to a cap (e.g., $5k/month) until the formal PO process is complete.

Attaching: OrchidAI_W9.pdf, MSA-draft-OrchidAI.pdf

Thanks — Suresh

--

Rishi —

Thanks for the context and for attaching the intake docs. Procurement will approve a temporary invoice-only onboarding path under these conditions:

1) Vendor evidence complete: W-9 on file (received), remittance details or ACH instructions provided, and a signed vendor intake form (Procurement-Temporary-Waiver-Form.pdf).
2) Threshold: temporary invoice-only cap set to $5,000 USD/month. Any month projected to exceed $5k requires pre-authorization and either a PO or escalation to finance.
3) Duration: waiver valid for up to 90 days from approval, or until the fully executed MSA is in place (whichever comes first).
4) Controls: invoices must be routed to AP with "TEMP-WAIVER-ORCHIDAI" in the memo; procurement will run a monthly spend check and will auto-revoke if anomalies occur.

I approved this in principle and have attached the completed short-form waiver template. Next steps for Rishi / Sales:
- Confirm remit address/ACH info from Orchid and upload W-9 + MSA draft to shared drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1aBcDeFGhIJkLmNoPqR
- Ask the customer to sign the Procurement-Temporary-Waiver-Form and return to billing@redwood.ai
- I will create the temporary vendor record and notify AP to accept invoices with the waiver memo.

Copying Priya for awareness on risk-review — if anything in their entity check flags, Priya, please advise.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Manager, Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
